items.title: 1. How long does it take to build a music streaming app?
body: Development typically takes 8-24 weeks, depending on app complexity, features, and platform (iOS, Android, or both). MVPs can launch faster.

items.title: 2. How much does it cost to develop a music streaming app?
body: Working with a music app development agency typically costs between $8,000 for a basic MVP and $150,000+ for an enterprise-level platform, depending on features and technology used.

items.title: 3. Can you integrate AI-based music recommendations into my app?
